bloques.titulo: It expresses the intention of the speaker; it presents a fixed plan or agenda.
texto: A dictionary form is used. The form of a dictionary or a name may appear before the first time. Not every plan is confirmed the same.

The aircraft is scheduled to leave at 3: 00 in the afternoon.
